approach: Static recompilation of the Xbox 360 binary with ReXGlue; native Linux AppImage and Windows build with a Qt launcher, in-game options menu, FSR and PipeWire audio
notes: v2.2 released: playable on Linux; the AppImage needs only glibc 2.38, so it is built to run on the Steam Deck (SteamOS 3.7). Windows test build; Android pre-release. v2.2 adds an unlocked frame rate (the game's physics are frame-rate independent), lower input latency (guest-side frame pacing, a one-frame queue, mailbox vsync), an in-game options menu (F1 or L3+R3) for frame cap, vsync, FSR/CAS upscaling, resolution, audio and controls, an FPS overlay, and a fix for a multi-GB /dev/shm leak on Linux. A fresh recomp: no earlier recomp or port of this game existed.
